headline: Anand Rathi projects strong renewable energy capacity growth through FY36
summary: Brokerage firm Anand Rathi forecasts that India's power capacity will expand at a 7.7 percent compound annual growth rate through fiscal 2036. This expansion is expected to be primarily driven by solar power growing at 13 percent and wind power at 10.7 percent. The report highlights a shifting power demand cycle favoring clean energy segments. Retail investors focusing on the power sector should evaluate long-term opportunities in renewable infrastructure developers like Clean Max and ACME Solar.
why_it_matters: Long-term tailwinds strengthen investment case for renewable energy stocks
